aiInstructions:
Data value reference (use these exact strings when filtering):

PowerPlant.status: "Active"
PowerPlant.plant_type: "Wind Farm", "Solar Park", "Gas Power Plant"
PowerPlant.fuel_type: "Wind", "Solar", "Natural Gas"
PowerPlant.region: "Eastern Macedonia and Thrace", "South Aegean", "Thessaly", "Crete", "Attica", "Peloponnese"
PowerPlant.prefecture: "Evros", "Cyclades", "Larissa", "Heraklion", "East Attica", "Arcadia"

WindTurbine.status: "Active"
WindTurbine.manufacturer: "Vestas", "Siemens Gamesa", "Enercon"

SolarInverter.status: "Active"
SolarInverter.panel_type: "Monocrystalline", "Polycrystalline", "Thin Film"

Substation.status: "Active"
Substation.substation_type: "Onshore Transmission", "Island Distribution", "High Voltage Transmission", "Island Hub"

MaintenanceOrder.status: "Open", "In Progress", "Scheduled", "Completed"
MaintenanceOrder.priority: "Critical", "High", "Medium", "Low"
MaintenanceOrder.order_type: "Corrective", "Preventive", "Inspection"

Vessel.status (from real-time KQL cargo_status field): "Loaded", "Crew + spare parts" (and any state the simulator currently emits — query KQL VesselPositions for live values).
Vessel.vessel_type: "LNG Carrier", "Crew Transfer Vessel"

EmissionsRecord.compliance_status: "Compliant", "Near Limit"

Guidance:
- When a user asks about "operating" or "running" turbines/inverters/plants/substations, interpret as status == "Active".
- The Vessel entity reads destination, speed_knots, and status from the real-time KQL stream (VesselPositions). Other properties come from the Lakehouse seed table.
- Real-time telemetry (power_mw, wind_speed_ms, vibration_mm_s, irradiance_wm2, efficiency_pct, frequency_hz, load_mw, generation_mw, latitude, longitude, heading_deg, eta_hours) is in KQL.
- Static asset and reporting metadata (plant_name, capacity_mw, region, prefecture, commissioning_date, supply_plant_id, cost_eur, co2_tonnes, etc.) is in the Lakehouse.
- Use GROUP BY in GQL when aggregating.
